facts.fact: The Uganda Registration Services Bureau says the Directorate of Civil Registration moved from URSB to the National Identification Registration Authority (NIRA) from 1 October 2024, putting civil registration and national identification under one body.

UGA.note: The notice names no digital civil registration system.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
The document says nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.
NIRA is named only as the receiving authority; nothing on the ID system itself.
A change of institutional home for civil registration; no registration system or office entry is described.
